changes: Lost or malformed responses show an unknown result and retry the original outcome
Payment-link retry retains an idempotency key scoped to the link
Concurrent session creation returns the unique-key winner
Pending result advises against starting another payment
Transaction reset updates both results and filter controls
Auth and recovery native form fallback uses POST

browser: Response dropped after server commit; retry preserves outcome and payment
Missing success fields are not treated as success
Failed and pending states display correctly
Expired checkout has no payment controls
Lost payment-link response reuses the same request key and session
History filters each status and an empty future range
Reset clears both fields and results
History has no viewport overflow at 1440/768/390
JavaScript-disabled login submits POST with no password query parameter

limitations: Simulated payments only; no real money processing tested
Network failure injected in local browser
No production data written or Git push performed
